idea-plugin.name: Quick Launch
idea-plugin.description: Quick Launch - Launch Terax, Netcatty, CMD, or any custom app from the IDE toolbar. Adds an icon to the main toolbar. Clicking it opens the current project root in the selected application.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 0.1.3: Restore original terax and netcatty icons extracted from executables.
  • 0.1.2: Fix plugin icon — move to META-INF/pluginIcon.svg for proper display.
  • 0.1.1: Fix toolbar icon display — switch to SVG icons for proper scaling.
  • 0.1.0: Initial release. Toolbar action to open current project in your preferred app.

action.description: Open current project in your preferred app
